ROOT = sys.argv[1]

        return [KIT, "-k", "not (icon_sprite or twin or tokens or connection_dot or composite)"]
    if mid.startswith("T"):
        return [KIT, "-k", "twin or composite"]
    return [ORA, KIT + "::test_v52_composite_twins_keep_nested_testids_unique_after_repainting"]

def run(args):

    failed = re.findall(r"^FAILED (\S+)", out.stdout, re.M)

log = open(LOG, "a", buffering=1)

    f = os.path.join(ROOT, path)
    original = open(f, "rb").read()

    if n != 1:
        log.write(f"{mid}\tSNIPPET-{'MISSING' if n == 0 else 'AMBIGUOUS'}({n})\t{path}\t{what}\n")

        code, failed, tail = 99, "TIMEOUT", ""
    finally:
        open(f, "wb").write(original)
    assert hashlib.sha256(open(f, "rb").read()).hexdigest() == hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
    verdict = "KILLED" if code != 0 else "SURVIVED"
    log.write(f"{mid}\t{verdict}\t{path}\t{what}\t{failed.split('::')[-1] if failed else ''}\t{int(time.time()-t0)}s\n")
PYEOF
